title: zero-dimensional-etale-cohomology-rest
statement:
Let u be a universe, k : Type u an algebraically closed field, C : Scheme.{u}, and f : C ⟶ Spec k a separated, locally finite-type, quasi-compact morphism. Assume topologicalKrullDim C ≤ 0. Let F be a sheaf of abelian groups in universe u+1 on the small étale site of C. For each underlying point x : C choose an algebraically closed field Ω(x) : Type u and a morphism s(x) : Spec Ω(x) ⟶ C whose unique source point maps to x. No algebraicity of Ω(x) over k or extra linearity condition on s(x) is assumed. Then (1) for every natural number q > 0 the abelian group H^q(C,F), computed by Etale.cohomology applied to F placed in degree zero by DerivedCategory.singleFunctor, is subsingleton; and (2) the canonical morphism from H^0(C,F) to the categorical product over x : C of the geometric stalks F_{s(x)} is an isomorphism. This morphism is precisely the composite of homologyRightDerivedFunctorObjSingleFunctorIso.hom, rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf.hom.app F, restriction F.ΓRes to the identity étale object C ⟶ C, and Pi.lift of the toPresheafFiber germs at s(x). The cohomology, site, abelian sheaves and geometric stalks are those of [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] and [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Finiteness is not an added hypothesis or a conjunct of this statement.

theorem zero_dimensional_etale_cohomology_rest (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] (C : Scheme.{u}) (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim C ≤ 0) (F : Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (Ω : C → Type u) [∀ x, Field (Ω x)] [∀ x, IsAlgClosed (Ω x)] (s : ∀ x : C, Spec (.of (Ω x)) ⟶ C) (hs : ∀ x : C, (s x).base.hom default = x) : (∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q → Subsingleton ((Etale.cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} C q).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) 0).obj F))) ∧ IsIso ((Functor.homologyRightDerivedFunctorObjSingleFunctorIso (Sheaf.Γ C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) F 0).hom ≫ (Functor.rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf (Sheaf.Γ C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).hom.app F ≫ F.ΓRes (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 C))) ≫ Pi.lift (fun x : C => (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (s x)).toPresheafFiber (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 C)) (Over.homMk (s x) (Category.comp_id (s x))) F.obj))

proof.text: Apply [zero-dimensional-global-sections-exact] to install finite-colimit preservation of global sections; finite-limit preservation is already available. The existing Functor.singleFunctorCompRightDerivedFunctorIso identifies RΓ(F[0]) with Γ(F)[0]. Apply homology in degree q > 0, use HomologicalComplex.isZero_single_obj_homology, transport IsZero through the displayed isomorphisms and apply AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero. Pair this vanishing with [zero-dimensional-etale-cohomology-iso], applied with the original geometric points, to obtain exactly the unchanged conjunction.
